articles.title: NBA 2K27 Is Teasing a GTA 6-Themed Event in Collaboration with Rockstar Games
articles.summary: NBA 2K27 is teasing a crossover with Rockstar Games, seemingly to promote Grand Theft Auto 6. At the end of the trailer for NBA 2K27 Season 1, there's a very cryptic tease.
body: Seasons tend to last about six weeks, so we can expect Season 3 to launch around the time of GTA 6's release in November. It's unclear what exactly this will offer, especially since NBA 2K is an E-rated game and the GTA series pushes the boundaries with its M-ratings. However, it appears to be part of a larger effort to ramp up marketing for what will undoubtedly be one of the biggest releases in entertainment history.

A lot of fans have been frustrated with the lack of marketing for GTA 6 up until now. There have been two trailers and some screenshots to go along with pre-orders, but that's about it as of right now. However, things will ramp up later this week when Rockstar Games releases an extended look at the game on Netflix. Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick previously teased a big marketing campaign for GTA 6, and it seems like the decision to partner with Netflix and Take-Two's other juggernaut franchise, NBA 2K, will help emphasize the significance of this release.
points: NBA 2K27 is teasing a crossover with Rockstar Games, seemingly to promote Grand Theft Auto 6.

articles.title: Marvel Tokon Devs Confess Regaining Trust After Fumbled PC Launch Will Be 'Extremely Challenging'
articles.summary: Arc System Works has apologized for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' PC launch and admitted it will be "extremely difficult" to regain player trust.
body: Producer Takeshi Yamanaka offered a post-mortem on the release of the studio's new superhero fighting game during an interview with VGC. He noted that, when it comes to the content itself, fans have mostly nice things to say about Marvel Tokon, but the positivity isn't being shared by users across all platforms.

"They’re playing matches every day, they’re in training mode, they’re coming up with new combos, and we see them posting those on social media," Yamanaka said. "However, at the same time, unfortunately, in the PC version of the game, there have been in-game issues experienced by many players, which we really apologise to the player base for all of these problems."

Marvel Tokon brought tag-team gameplay to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S August 6, 2026. While reviewers largely lobbed high scores its way (IGN gave it a 9/10 ), those on PC instead took to Steam to leave reviews of their own.

articles.title: Latest GTA 6 Leak References Irony Of The Game Being A Digital-Exclusive
articles.summary: Yet another alleged GTA 6 leak has emerged, showing off one of the game's main characters, Jason, visiting a video game store that sells physical discs. This has prompted people to point out the irony of GTA 6 being a digital-exclusive game.
body: In the clip, we see Jason visit a store called Game Horde where he uses binoculars to zoom in on the shelves, showing various games and consoles.
"This is not about actual discs. It's about ownership. Resale rights still matter, even in a digital-only era," reads a watermark on the video.

GTA 6 will be sold at brick-and-mortar retailers, but the game's physical edition only includes a code in the box. The data shows that more and more people, on a percentage basis, are buying games digitally today. But a lot of people still want physical game discs, while many have also expressed concerns about game preservation concerns in a digital-only era.
For more, check out GameSpot's timeline of the GTA 6 leaks so far.

articles.title: The Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 Costs $1,300, And The OLED Screen Better Be Worth It
articles.summary: Almost a year after launch, the Asus Xbox ROG Ally is getting an upgrade--and a hefty price increase--in the form of the X20 model. body: What does an extra $300 get you? The biggest draw is the screen, as Asus has equipped this model with a 7.4‑inch 1080p OLED 120Hz HDR display. The shell is also constructed from translucent plastic so you can see the inner workings of the ROG Ally X20, and those internals include an 80Wh battery, 1TB of storage capacity, 24GB of DDR5 RAM, and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity. The X20 also features a redesigned layout meant to improve airflow and thermal efficiency, as these units can get hot while running demanding games.

Asus added that it has improved the D-pad and installed TMR magnetic induction analog sticks. The unit still runs on the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme processor, which is capable of handling modern games smoothly. If you've got $2,500 to spare, you can also grab a bundle deal that includes the ROG Ally X20, a pair of 240Hz ROG XReal X1 glasses, a Dbrand Killswitch protective case set, and a Pelican case to store everything in.

articles.title: Why GTA Games Are A “Stab In The Heart,” But Also Amazing, For Ex-Dishonored Dev
articles.summary: According to industry veteran Raphaël Colantonio, who worked on the Dishonored series at Arkane before starting his own studio, GTA games are "the biggest tease" and also "the biggest disappointment" for people who love immersive sim games.
body: "I don't mean that in an offensive way because of course who am I and who are they? They make games that sell I don't know how many thousands times more than mine and they are so incredible at doing surface simulation," he told Press Box PR. "But that’s such a stab in the heart for me when they don’t go more than surface level where there’s no long-term consequences to anything you do."
GTA games, instead, offer more of a "fantastic sandbox with incredible execution, incredible cinematography, [and] great gameplay," Colantonio added.

He went on to say Rockstar has a formula and that he "understands why they do it." At the same time, Colantonio said a game like Skyrim is more to his liking. He said in Skyrim, there is "just one instance of the world," so your actions have real, meaningful, and lasting consequences.
"You really own your consequences as a player. Everything is playable and you have to deal with your choices for the rest of the game," he said.

articles.title: 'GTA 6' Hacker's New Leak Is Total Rage Bait For Rockstar
articles.summary: After over a dozen Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay leaks, hacking group Cyberleek is evidently still intent on poking the bear. The group has spent an entire week taunting and mocking Take-Two Interactive, GTA 6 's publisher, alongside developer Rockstar Games.
body: When the August 2026 leaks first surfaced, Cyberleek claimed that the group's decision to publish unauthorized gameplay of GTA 6 was motivated by Rockstar and Take-Two's decision to sell the game without physical discs. Early clips threatened that Cyberleek would continue sharing more leaks unless Take-Two changed course on its controversial business decision. Despite ample evidence that the hacking group wants to maximize leak profits, Cyberleek is continuing to peddle that activist narrative for its 14th gameplay leak.

The latest two-minute GTA 6 leak shows game co-protagonist Jason walking into a brick-and-mortar shop called Game Hoard. The store is full of physical game boxes, and therefore discs, on which Jason zooms in on. The games reference all sorts of popular real-world titles, like Elden Ring and Returnal. The player stops to look at a sign encouraging people to trade-in games — which is only possible when you have a physical disc.
"This is not about discs," reads a caption on the footage. "It is about ownership. Resale rights still matter — even in a digital age."

articles.title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 report - all the news and announcements as Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past shown for first time
articles.summary: German mega-show Gamescom officially gets under way this evening with the Opening Night Live showcase hosted by Geoff "bright trainers" Keighley. And we'll be covering all of the news and announcements live, right here, in this article.
body: The main show begins at 7pm BST (8pm CEST / 2pm EDT / 11am PDT), with a pre-show starting half-an-hour earlier. It's expected to end by 9pm BST so the main show runs for roughly two hours.

What to expect? The big one for me is a first proper look at The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past, because we barely know anything about it yet. We know it's featuring in Opening Night Live and this glimpse should clarify what the setting is and what new features we can expect.

Elsewhere, I'm excited to see footage of Dungeons & Dragons third-person action game Warlock, because we've only seen a CGI teaser until now, and we know we're going to get a look at the third and final Final Fantasy 7 remake instalment Revelation. Might we also see something more of the new Alien: Isolation 2 game? And I wonder if ArenaNet might show us Guild Wars 3. And could Blizzard announce Diablo 4 on Switch 2?

Besides reveals, we're expecting a flurry of release dates. We still don't have a date for The Duskbloods, which is still set to be out this year, nor the Zelda Ocarina of Time remake, though it'd be a surprise to see a big Nintendo announcement like that here. Much to hope for but what will we get?

articles.title: "People wanted faster movement, but not this fast" - Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta players aren't happy with slide spammers and the increased pace of the game
articles.summary: The first session of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta is nearly over after five days of multiplayer action. The beta saw high player numbers on Steam and elsewhere, despite mainly being available to players who pre-ordered the game.
body: "Just a reminder - the COD YouTubers and streamers literally begged for this movement," reads the title of a popular post on the Modern Warfare 4 subreddit. "I've been in and out of the COD YouTube space for some time now, and one thing that's been abundantly clear to me is that nearly every single one wants this cracked movement. There comes a point where you can't even blame [ Infinity Ward ] for making this movement, because all of the content creators giving them feedback have literally been begging COD every single game to crank movement to the maximum and make everything as fast as humanly possible."

Reddit user KARMAAACS agreed, saying: "I think people wanted faster movement, but not this fast. It's all relative. We don't want [Modern Warfare 2]'s slow movement, but we also don't want what is basically instantly mantling and everyone sliding around like in [Modern Warfare 4]."

articles.title: The Witcher 4's 2028 release date sparks PS5 physical release concerns, but is there anything CD Projekt Red can do to avoid Sony's decision?
articles.summary: The Witcher 4 's newly communicated 2028 release date is causing concern among its community about whether the game releases physically on a disc or not.
body: CD Projekt Red announced yesterday it's "targeting" a 2028 release date for The Witcher 4, though it didn't specify when in the year it's aiming for. "I know it's a bit of a wait and you'd love to play it sooner, but let the team cook," joint-CEO Michal Nowakowski announced in a video.

The concerning part of that is The Witcher 4 arrives after Sony plans to stop producing discs for PlayStation games - a move which comes into effect January 2028, and which includes the making of discs for third-party games, which The Witcher 4 is. "Physical game disc production for all new games releasing on PlayStation consoles will be discontinued starting January 2028," Sony previously said.
This does not bode well for a disc-based release, and CDPR has not said anything in relation to it - I've asked for comment, incidentally. But the concern amongst the community is plain.
